text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Dammit!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Nooooo! I looooost!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I might've lost, but... but...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up! I'm gonna get
stronger!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win so badly—I ran my heart
out! But
Taishin and Hayahide ran their
hearts out too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: After all that, I still lost, and that hurts! But it's because it hurts that I'll train to get even faster!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'll put everything I have into it, even
this pain I
feel! I'm going run even
fasteeeer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! The Kikuka Sho will be miiiiine!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
(Ticket... She lost the race of her
dreams, but
she's already working
toward her next goal.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: (Her presence is overwhelming...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Taishin have grown
tremendously since
fully realizing their
abilities...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I must recalculate my strategy right
away!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hey...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Sure, she didn't win, but she still made it
on the
scoreboard. That's an
achievement in and of
itself.
Besides...
Hmph. I know.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I refuse to let anyone say things are over
for me
just 'cause I lost here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Not when I still have the Kikuka Sho to
win!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The finale of the Triple Crown tour, the
Kikuka
Sho, awaits us next.

She reaffirms her dedication to keep
pushing on,
so she can seize the next
crown.
I have to win.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: As long as I win, then one day...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
